description: Bay extension modules grow a ship's special holds or give it one it lacks: the Mining Hold, Fuel Bay, Expedition Hold, Salvage Hold, Ammo Hold, Mineral Hold and Planetary Commodities Hold, in three sizes from T1 to T2. Every bay a module adds works like one the hull was built with, items go to and come from the right bay, and a bay that still holds cargo cannot be taken off the ship. Other Reverie mods use it to give their own modules and ships a bay.

fields.label: Loot All sends items to their bay
fields.description: When you loot a wreck or can into your cargo hold in space, items that a bay of your ship takes go to that bay instead, as long as it has room.

fields.label: Mining lasers spill into cargo
fields.description: When every mining hold that takes the ore is full, a mining laser puts what it mines into the cargo hold. Off is the base game's rule: the laser stops.

fields.label: Module output that does not fit goes into a can
fields.description: When a module of another Reverie mod makes something that fits in none of your bays, it is left in a can in space beside you. Off, the module stops instead.

fields.label: Bay extensions in NPC loot (multiplier)
fields.description: Scales how often NPC miners, haulers, salvagers and warships drop a bay extension. 0 turns it off.

fields.label: T1 extension blueprints on the market
fields.description: The T1 blueprints are sold wherever the market sells the Expanded Cargohold I Blueprint. T2 blueprints are always invented.

fields.label: Bays on other mods' modules
fields.description: Modules from other Reverie mods carry the bays they ask for, such as the Salvage Hold on a salvager.

fields.label: Show bay meters
fields.description: Small meters above the ship display show how full each of your ship's bays is.
